scope: Remove distant source geometry silhouettes over the Slipstream lagoon using the existing fog visibility pass; no authored geometry, assets, movement, collision or trial rules change.
diagnosis: At the coil exit, upper forest surfaces 1.3–2 km away retain opaque fog-coloured silhouettes against the painted sky. Smaller distant course surfaces behave the same way.
implementation: Reuse Nightworks identity visibility wrappers for the authored waterpark-island look, preserving individual object visibility and collision references.
Centre forest mesh bounds on their real vertices rather than their y=0 authoring origins; retain a 12 m margin and movement allowance.
Expand the radial fog range to contain both cameras’ fog-plane corners, avoiding premature removal at wide viewport edges.
Keep sky, ocean and the independently managed scenery/matte batches on their existing presentation paths. Clear inspection or disabled fog restores all wrappers.
checks: complete 4.093 km eight-rider native browser race

preliminaryLite.note: Five views of the first candidate before conservative viewport-corner expansion; final full/portrait views use the completed build.
